timers.mutationPolicy: Factory only. Public HTTPS sources, robots, Japan namespace unchanged, daily request/storage quotas. No editorial SQL/Redis writes or automatic training; public reader delivery remains with qualified canonical publication.
timers.ownerAuthorization: Explicit continuous 24/7 recursive manga completion request on 2026-10-15

timers.source: docker exec pg_dump/pg_restore --list (aphrody-postgres-1), redis-cli --rdb + redis-check-rdb (aphrody-redis-1), SQLite online backup + quick_check

timers.retention: rotation 1: the newest snapshot, kept once verified and restored; older ones deleted

timers.mutationPolicy: read-only; no DNS, worker deploy, R2 copy or tunnel config mutation
temporary scoped credential renewal only; no DNS, worker deploy, R2 objects or tunnel mutation

rules: no crawler runs continuously in production
primary-data backup creation is infra-owned on dbfr (shenron-container-backup); the VPS shenron-offsite-backup only pulls, verifies SHA-256 and restores into a disposable container
the Shenron offsite pull runs on the always-on VPS (systemd timer, Persistent=true), not on the owner PC
DBFR keeps the two newest container snapshots; the VPS copy fails loudly when the newest DBFR snapshot is older than 36 h
shenron-container-backup owns every Shenron data class on dbfr (PostgreSQL, Redis, bot and server SQLite); the former VPS shenron-backup and the host shenron-pg-backup timers are retired
no database has more than one active mirror direction
cleanup never touches active release, primary data or non-regenerable assets
